title: Granblue Fantasy Universal Workflow Action & Command Specification
description: Comprehensive reference of all executable actions and settings for GBF workflow templates. Templates define an automation routine using 'code' as the action identifier.

templateConfigOptions.description: Top-level template settings configured directly in the template JSON root. All safety and humanization options are ON by default.

options.description: Applies natural human motor behavior (2D Gaussian micro-jitter on clicks/taps, randomized reaction delays, and bezier curve cursor movement) to prevent bot detection.
Monitors the screen for Cygames verification challenges / image CAPTCHAs. If detected, freezes automation immediately, brings browser to front, sounds audible beeps, and pauses until solved.
Automatically consumes Half-Elixirs when AP drops below quest entry requirements.
Automatically consumes Soul Berries when joining raids from #quest/assist with insufficient EP.
Target search slot (1-4) on Backup Requests (#quest/assist). Slot 4 = PBHL, Slot 3 = Akasha, Slot 2 = GO HL.
Multi-slot rotation list on Backup Requests (#quest/assist). The engine scans across slots in order (e.g. [4, 3, 2]), picking the first eligible raid card before refreshing.
Priority list of summon names scanned if the auto-selected supporter popup is not pre-selected.
Execution Mode: 'combat' (default supporter selection & battle pipeline) | 'routine' (arbitrary page navigation, dailies, fate stories) | 'assist' (multi-raid backup finder).
FAST (150ms delays) | STEALTH (850ms human pauses) | TURBO (sub-50ms ultra speed).
Default number of quest repeats if not passed as CLI argument.

stepFieldReference.description: Properties configured inside each step object of the 'steps' array.

fields.code: REQUIRED. The action code to execute (e.g. 'tap_ready', 'reload', 'attack', 'wait', 'skill', 'summon', 'loop_while', 'skip_story_scene'). You MUST use 'code' as the property key — do NOT use 'action', 'name', or 'id'.
fields.waitForNetwork: Network endpoint to await before proceeding (e.g. 'summon_result.json', 'normal_attack_result.json').
fields.targetCharacter: Optional 1-indexed target party member (1 to 4) for targeted character skills (e.g. Nier S2 on Ilsa/Char 2).
fields.target: CSS selector or navigation URL for 'click', 'navigate', 'guard', 'wait_element', or condition for 'loop_while'/'loop_until'.
fields.conditionElement: Alternative CSS selector property for 'loop_while' and 'loop_until'.
fields.maxLoops: Maximum loop safety ceiling for 'loop_while' and 'loop_until' (defaults to 50).
fields.subSteps: Array of child WorkflowStep objects executed inside 'repeat', 'loop_while', or 'loop_until' blocks.
fields.delayAfterMs: Optional pause in milliseconds after completing this step.
